<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: mark-phase-skipped -->
**Mark Phase Skipped:** The agent frequently completes work and commits but forgets to set
"passes": true in plan.md. This causes the next iteration to re-attempt
the same task, wasting cycles.

Observed in: AngryBirds (1x), DissonantDreams-Unity (1x), EventDesignedLearning (5x), campaign-finance-network (60x), comfyprompts (5x), drawing-agent (6x), flavor-network (61x), gym-mouse (1x), mod-my-week-platform (104x), murder-mystery (7x), prediction_betting (4x), ralph-universal (49x), unity-py-sim (16x)
  Fix: 1. PROMPT.md Phase 6 (Mark) must be bold with explicit "CRITICAL" warning
2. Manager review checks if the diff includes a passes:true change in plan.md
3. If the last commit message references a task but plan.md wasn't updated, flag it

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: ui-projects-need-test-infrastructure -->
**Ui Projects Need Test Infrastructure:** JavaScript/React projects consistently lack test infrastructure. 84% of
flavor-network iterations had no test coverage. mod-my-week-platform had 0%
test involvement and was the ONLY project with gate failures (3 failures on
audit/refactoring tasks).
Observed in: flavor-network (84% test gap), mod-my-week-platform (0% tests, 3 gate failures), EventDesignedLearning (inconsistent)
  Fix: 1. Bootstrap test infrastructure (jest, react-testing-library) in project setup phase
2. Add test-writing as first-class task category in plan.md
3. Gate should warn (not block) when source files change without corresponding test files
4. Template test suites for common patterns (component rendering, API calls, state management)

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: repetition-drawing-agent-run-the-15-prompt-mvp-eval-end-to-e -->
**Repetition Drawing Agent Run The 15 Prompt Mvp Eval End To E:** Task repeated 3 times without progress in drawing-agent: Run the 15-prompt MVP eval end-to-end live: 15 HF generations + 15 LLM-judge sco

Stuck task: Run the 15-prompt MVP eval end-to-end live: 15 HF generations + 15 LLM-judge scorings + user scores at least 3 items (15 rows). Persist the run_id to a baselines registry so later phases can measure d

Iterations: 0–2 (run consumed 3 loops with no plan progress).

Observed in: drawing-agent
  Fix: 1. Stop running the same task. After two consecutive iterations with no mark-phase commit, decompose into smaller subtasks in `plan.md` before the next attempt. Stuck task: `Run the 15-prompt MVP eval end-to-end live: 15 HF generations + 15 LLM-judge scorings + user scores at least 3 items (15`.
2. Inspect the last failing diagnose output (`smart_gate.py --diagnose`) and address the specific error the previous iteration produced — don't restart from scratch.
3. If decomposition isn't possible, escalate to a human. Three failed iterations is the budget; a fourth burns more API spend than rewriting the spec.
4. After applying any of the above, tag the commit message with `<lesson_applied stem='repetition-drawing-agent-run-the-15-prompt-mvp-eval-end-to-e' how='N' />` where N is the step you used. This is how the corpus learns whether the lesson is actually working (see docs/bridge-protocol.md §4h).
